summary: NVIDIA's Parakeet and Nemotron speech models, offline on your computer: subtitles from a file in 33 languages with accurate word timing, speaker labels if you want them, and live captions while you record in 28. Parakeet (714 MB) transcribes the 25 European languages and Nemotron (742 MB) the others and the live captions; each downloads the first time it is needed.
author: Subtitld

models.display_name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (25 European languages, files)
Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B (28 languages, live captions)

fields.label: Model

options.label: Automatic: Parakeet where it covers the language, Nemotron elsewhere
Parakeet: 25 European languages, the most accurate timing
Nemotron: 28 languages, including Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Turkish and Vietnamese

fields.help: For files. Parakeet makes fewer mistakes and writes numbers as digits; Nemotron's word timing is estimated, so its cues can start a little early or late. Live captions always use Nemotron.

fields.label: One cue per sentence
fields.help: On: one subtitle per sentence, however long. Off: a long sentence is split into subtitles of about two lines or 7 seconds at most.

fields.label: Label speakers
fields.help: Tells up to 8 speakers apart in a file (A, B, C...) and starts a new subtitle when the speaker changes. Downloads a 107 MB speaker model the first time and adds a pass over the audio of about a twentieth of its length. Not used for live captions.

fields.label: Live caption delay

options.label: 160 ms: the quickest, the most mistakes

fields.help: How far ahead Nemotron listens before it writes a word while you record. Longer is more accurate.
